displayDescription: Simulated clay idea-bulb pushes out sage coils that press in four clay nodes on a dusty-cerulean painted card, shot on twos.
styleRenderer: Three.js 0.186.1 WebGLRenderer (procedural matte clay meshes, PCF soft shadows, seeded canvas bump textures)
motionEngine: GSAP 3 paused timeline window.__timelines.video (composition clock + title overlay)
GSAP paused pose timeline sampled at 12 exposures/s (all clay pose values)
audioDescription: Silent preview: no audio track, music, effects or voice.
limitations: Digital simulation of claymation: no clay was sculpted or photographed; Blender was not used per user instruction.

Clay is approximated with displaced Three.js spheres/tubes, matte MeshStandardMaterial and seeded procedural bump maps (fingerprints, dents, grit); no subsurface scattering or real plasticine micro-detail.
Coil growth is a revealed tube draw range with a rolled tip cap, not true volume-conserving extrusion; squash/stretch is approximately volume-preserving by scale.
Stop-motion stepping is 12 exposures/s held on a 30 fps delivery; title overlay is a smooth digital layer by design.
No depth-of-field blur; replacement mouths are three discrete meshes.
Backdrop #4F7F96 is a scene-chosen painted card informed by the reviewed source's flat single-hue backdrop, not copied from it.
Title typography uses OS-bundled Arial Rounded MT Bold / Trebuchet MS declared via @font-face local(); if absent on the render host, the CSS stack falls back to Helvetica Neue/Arial.
